analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported strong revenue and profit growth for the first half of FY27, driven by higher turnover, domestic market focus, premium model launches, and trading activities. Management highlighted that raw material prices and increased export freight costs impacted margins, but sourcing efficiencies and new OEM partnerships with brands like Titan and Amazon supported business expansion. The company targets revenue of Rs. 300 crores to Rs. 350 crores and a PAT of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects turnover to increase by 30% to 40% more than expected in the next two quarters.
guidance.quote: Yes. And secondly, as you said, in the next two quarters, we hope that the turnover will increase by 30% to 40% more than what we expected.

guidance.claim: The company targets a minimum PAT of around Rs. 12 crore to Rs. 14 crore for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Turnover will increase and 100% we hope that minimum PAT should come around Rs. 12 crore to Rs. 14 crore in this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects full year revenue to be around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore.
guidance.quote: According to us revenue is around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore. We hope it should be that.

guidance.claim: The company expects full-year revenue growth to be between 25% and 30%.
guidance.quote: I wanted to ask, Q1 FY’27 revenue grew by 75.6% on a year-on-year basis, you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management projects revenue for the next quarter to be at least Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is coming more from domestic markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, our growth is coming more from domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that export demand was lower due to increased freight costs.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is targeting the development of clocks in the Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 price range for the 2027-28 period.
demand_outlook.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: Imported goods have an average margin of 3% to 4%, while trading and manufacturing activities have a 21% gross profit.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: Freight cost accounts for 30% to 40% of other expenses.
Raw material prices increased in the market, leading management to offer special schemes and discounts to grow the business.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, the raw material prices got increased in the market but we focused more on the business and by giving special schemes and special discount we grew the business.

margins_costs.claim: The company manages raw material price volatility by purchasing inventory in advance for six to seven months.
margins_costs.quote: At the time when the raw material is expected to increase, we purchase raw material for six, seven months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins are currently fluctuating due to daily changes in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing.

orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is between 60% and 70%.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend paid including corporate dividend tax was -120.10 lakhs for the period ending 30-09-2026.
The company does not require additional borrowing to fund future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs for exports have increased significantly.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export volumes have seen a slight impact due to price increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch eight to ten new models in the coming two to three months.
management_commitments.quote: And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets providing maximum benefit to shareholders and achieving a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore with an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 by 2028-2029.
management_commitments.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to develop and sell clocks in the Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 range.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
